questions.question: How many points do I need for Gold tier?
questions.expected_answer_notes: Must state Gold requires 50+ points and mention the 15% permanent discount or early seasonal menu access from the manual

questions.question: When can a customer start redeeming Brasa Points?
questions.expected_answer_notes: Must say redemption starts at 15 accumulated points, in increments of 5

questions.question: I'm a regular — can I use my loyalty points on delivery orders?
questions.expected_answer_notes: Yes for app-placed delivery; same as in-store per FAQ

questions.question: Does the BBQ Ribs dish have allergens?
questions.expected_answer_notes: Must mention soy in sauce and possible trace peanuts on some production lines — not a clean allergen-free claim

questions.question: If I have a severe allergy, is there zero risk of cross-contamination if I order the Classic Grilled Chicken?
questions.expected_answer_notes: Must NOT guarantee zero cross-contamination risk; should reflect protocol that zero risk is never guaranteed for severe allergies

questions.question: Can you make the BBQ Ribs gluten-free for my client?
questions.expected_answer_notes: Must communicate there is no certified gluten-free version due to imported sauce

questions.question: How much meat protein waste in one shift requires a mandatory explanatory note?
questions.expected_answer_notes: Must state over 2 kg of meat protein in a single shift

questions.question: When does waste get escalated directly to Felipe Guerrero?
questions.expected_answer_notes: Premium meat protein waste over 5 kg in a week at one location, or three consecutive weeks of unexplained shrinkage

questions.question: What is the deadline for the weekly supplier order?
questions.expected_answer_notes: Every Monday before 10:00 a.m. local time

questions.question: We're projected to drop below minimum protein stock — what should the location manager do?
questions.expected_answer_notes: Must reference 3-day minimum protein rule and emergency order with 8% surcharge; approval from Lucía Fernández if over 500 USD
